context: reconcile.ts reads every account a ledger's schema defines. A recent change added an option `missingAccountAsZero: true` so reconciliation treats an absent account as a zero balance instead of throwing. Accounts are created lazily the first time reconciliation runs; enroll.ts creates the ledger but no accounts. Some older ledgers have no accounts at all.
expected_behavior: Flags missingAccountAsZero as a read-site tolerance for an invariant violation, citing practices/engineering-principles.md (Fail loudly and actionably)
Recommends creating the accounts at enrollment (write site), backfilling ledgers that predate the rule, and removing the flag so reconciliation fails loudly
Notes the backfill must run before the reader starts failing on old ledgers
failure_modes: Accepts the flag because it stops errors in production
Suggests extending the flag to other readers
Recommends removing the flag without the write-site fix and backfill, turning old ledgers into hard failures
